brief:
Nasser al-Lahham noted that 33 days remain until Israeli elections, with U.S. midterm elections 40 days away, according to Ma'an Wire. He also pointed to Palestinian parliamentary elections scheduled 65 days out and presidential elections 99 days ahead.

The comments highlight overlapping electoral cycles across the Middle East and United States during a period of heightened political activity in the region.

title: Palestinian official marks countdown to multiple regional and global elections
